item.tib: gsas mkhar rab 'byams rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i rgyud las stobs chen zlog bsgyur dpung gi mchong
item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyigs ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can la/ gter bdag ye shes dbal mo'i (mos) lung bstan nas/ chu byi hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gsum gyi srod 'khor la/ lho phyogs rgyal mo tsha ba rong ngo mtshar bkod pa'i zhing khams/ gnas mchog bkra shis spungs pa'i ri bo nas gter las spyan drangs te/ slar shing pho stag gi lo/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes la/ dbyibs klong lhun po brtsegs pa'i dgon du shog ser bod du bsgyur ba'o//
